attribution.note: The intelligence_index field is computed from data published by ai-leaderboard.dev, with its method, and requires attribution wherever it is shown. Every other field is measured with the CordatusAI LLM Benchmark Tool.

memory.note: Inputs to the memory side of the capacity estimate. memory_gb is per GPU for DGX B300 and RTX PRO 6000, per node for DGX Spark and per module for Thor; a run uses tp x dp x pp of them. Weights are the served checkpoint's size (weights_gb on each row), or parameters x weight_bytes_per_param when the checkpoint is not known. The KV cache is assumed stored at kv_cache_bytes_per_value bytes per value (1 = FP8) for every row, whatever the weight precision. Each entry's kv_* fields are generated by _tools/kv_geometry.py from the model's config.json in _tools/model_meta/ and describe the model, not the run.
